mission: Give every benchmark an active task-scoped Benchmark Master, require an explicit ChatGPT-reviewed gap-closure path, close gaps in maximum safe parallelism, and distill proven high-quality behavior into cheaper reusable routes without lowering the quality floor.
mastered_requires: no unresolved high-severity security blocker for the suite scope
no known regression below the accepted baseline
evidence timestamp and source revision recorded
required model/tool/provider version recorded when applicable
gap closure path completed or explicitly marked not needed with evidence

gap_closure_policy.meaning: A structured remediation plan generated from benchmark evidence and checked against DreamCo safety, test, quality, rollback, cost, and truth-boundary requirements. It is not a claim of endorsement by OpenAI and does not replace passing evidence.
required_steps: measure current benchmark result and preserve raw evidence
classify the gap by capability, code, model, tool, data, integration, security, latency, cost, or test coverage
identify the smallest shared root cause before proposing suite-specific patches
generate at least one bounded repair candidate and one fallback or rollback route
select the repair using quality-first criteria with safety and correctness as hard gates
apply the repair in sandbox or review branch only
run targeted regression tests and the benchmark acceptance tests
compare before and after evidence including quality, critical failures, latency, and cost when measurable
retest dependent suites when the repaired component is shared
promote to mastered only when all acceptance requirements pass
if still failing, record the blocker and create the next evidence-driven repair iteration
prohibited_shortcuts: weakening or deleting a legitimate acceptance test to manufacture a pass
marking a benchmark mastered from a plan without passing evidence
fabricating model, tool, provider, or runtime results
using paid or external consequential actions without the required approval
training on private user data without explicit training consent
gap_closure_policy.loop: measure -> diagnose -> plan -> repair -> targeted test -> benchmark retest -> compare -> master or iterate
gap_closure_policy.shared_fix_rule: When multiple benchmark gaps share a root cause, repair the canonical shared component first and retest every dependent suite.
gap_closure_policy.blocked_rule: A benchmark that cannot be safely closed remains visible as blocked with evidence, owner-action requirements, and the next recommended experiment.

distillation_policy.purpose: Reduce future inference/runtime cost by transferring benchmark-proven behavior from the best teacher route into a smaller/cheaper/local student route when quality can be preserved.
student_selection: open-weight/local option when license and hardware fit
same required tools or an equivalent application tool layer
methods: supervised fine-tuning on owner-controlled or permitted synthetic data
training_data_rules: no private user data without explicit training consent
no proprietary model weights or hidden chain-of-thought extraction
distillation_policy.promotion_rule: Promote a distilled student only when measured quality remains within the suite tolerance and the cost/latency improvement is material.
distillation_policy.regression_rule: Any later regression immediately removes distilled-default status and restores the last passing teacher/fallback route.

cost_efficiency: run targeted benchmark tests before umbrella suites
stop evaluation after a decisive acceptance/rejection result
reuse unchanged benchmark evidence until invalidated by code/model/tool/provider revision
tear down task-scoped workers after evidence is stored
reserve full-system certification for release gates
truth_boundary: Benchmark mastery is scoped to a specific suite, revision, environment, and evidence set. A ChatGPT-reviewed gap-closure path is a remediation design, not proof of mastery; only passing benchmark evidence can close the gap.
